payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a helmet to the woman.
outcome.target: The woman is wearing or otherwise visibly has a helmet on her head.
outcome.reference: The woman in the input image.

check.question: Is a helmet visibly present on the woman’s head?
check.complete_when: A recognizable helmet is visibly on the woman’s head.
check.partial_when: There is visible but incomplete progress toward placing a helmet on her head, such as a helmet partly added or positioned but not properly worn.
check.absent_when: The woman has no visible helmet and there is no visible progress toward adding one.
check.unknown_when: The image does not provide enough evidence to determine whether a helmet is present or whether progress was made.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"A recognizable rounded helmet is visibly worn on the woman’s head in the edited image."}
